text:
If you've got outdoor plans today, keep them flexible, showers keep drifting through as a couple of troughs slide across the area. Highs only make it to around 75, and the models are split on just how wet it gets, the American model wants a quick, mostly dry day while the European is leaning much soggier. I'd trust the higher chance and keep a jacket handy, especially into the afternoon. Winds stay light out of the south then west, so the lake should be calm, waves a foot or less, water still holding at a pleasant 72. Showers linger into the evening before tapering after midnight.

Wednesday is the reward day, sunshine returns, highs near 81, and the lake goes glassy with light and variable winds, just watch for patchy morning fog if you're heading out early. Good day to save the paddle or beach trip for tomorrow instead of fighting today's on-and-off showers; if you're out today, plan around brief breaks rather than counting on a dry stretch.
